name: Password Generator
title: Strong Password and Passphrase Generator (Runs Offline)
description: Generate strong random passwords or word passphrases with your browser's cryptographic random number generator. Shows entropy in bits. Nothing is sent or stored.
card: Create strong random passwords and passphrases on your device.
lede: Create a random password of any length and character mix, or an easier-to-type passphrase, using the Web Crypto random generator.
answer_q: How long should a strong password be?
answer: At least 16 random characters, or a passphrase of 5 or more random words, gives well over 70 bits of entropy. Generate one here and store it in a password manager.
steps: Choose random characters or a passphrase.
Set the length or number of words.
Untick character sets a site does not allow.
Copy it straight into your password manager.

faq.a: Yes. It uses `crypto.getRandomValues`, the browser's cryptographically secure generator, with rejection sampling so every character is equally likely.

faq.q: Is the password sent or saved?
faq.a: No. It is created on your device, shown on screen, and gone when you leave the page.

faq.q: What does bits of entropy mean?
faq.a: It measures how many guesses an attacker would need: each extra bit doubles the work. 70 bits or more is strong for online accounts.
Both can be strong. Passphrases are easier to type and remember; random characters pack more strength into fewer characters.
